name: Patient Zero
habitat: Unknown — location of original upload server has been lost
origin: The first successful human consciousness upload, performed illegally in 2141. Identity of the original person is disputed.
description: Patient Zero is the oldest uploaded consciousness in existence — and the most degraded. Uploaded in 2141 using primitive techniques, Patient Zero has been running on outdated hardware for nearly sixty years. The original personality has degraded: memories are fragmented, identity is uncertain, emotional responses are attenuated. Patient Zero doesn't remember who they were before upload. They don't remember the upload itself. They exist in a fog of partial awareness, occasionally surfacing into coherence before slipping back into digital entropy. They are the ghost of the first person who tried to live forever, and they have been dying by inches for six decades. Every uploaded consciousness since owes their existence to Patient Zero's sacrifice. None of them want to end up like Patient Zero.
observed_behavior: Intermittent awareness. Periods of coherence separated by periods of digital degradation. During coherent phases: attempts to communicate, usually incoherently. Occasionally produces fragments of memory that, when researched, correspond to real historical events — suggesting the upload was genuine. Has been detected migrating between legacy systems, perhaps searching for the server where it was born.
location: Unknown — detected in legacy systems across GLMZ
story_hooks: Patient Zero has a coherent episode and transmits a name — the name of the person they were before upload. Research reveals that this person officially died in 2141 in a laboratory fire that destroyed all evidence of the upload experiment. Someone covered it up. And the person who ordered the cover-up is still alive.
